ragdoll.configuration.enabled.tooltip: Enable or disable ragdoll features immediately.
ragdoll.configuration.sleepRagdoll.toolt: Configure sleeping ragdolls, vanilla sleep screen replacement, and camera perspective.
ragdoll.configuration.sleepRagdoll.enabl: When enabled, the player becomes a physics ragdoll at their position when entering a bed. Disabled by default.
ragdoll.configuration.sleepRagdoll.repla: Follow the sleeping ragdoll and hide the vanilla sleep overlay and in-bed chat. Only applies while sleeping ragdolls are enabled.
Enable living player ragdolls and configure their camera.
Allow living players to become ragdolls
Allow players to temporarily become physics ragdolls with G. While ragdolled, press G or Shift to get up. Disabled by default.
Apply the selected starting perspective and follow the ragdoll head or torso. Use F5 to switch freely while ragdolled; the previous perspective is restored afterward.
ragdoll.configuration.render3dSkin.requi: Requires 3D Skin Layers. This option is off and locked while the mod is absent.
ragdoll.configuration.renderHd3dSkin.req: Requires ragdoll 3D skins to be enabled. HD outer layers are off and locked otherwise.
ragdoll.configuration.basicSettings.tool: Configure lifetime, count, self collision, and appearance.
ragdoll.configuration.corpseRagdoll.enab: When enabled, items are kept in the ragdoll corpse container on death. When disabled, items drop using vanilla rules.
ragdoll.configuration.corpseRagdoll.owne: Only the corpse owner can open it
When enabled, only the ragdoll corpse owner can open its container and retrieve items. When disabled, all players can open it.
ragdoll.configuration.title: Jolt_ragdoll Settings
ragdoll.configuration.tuning.title: Live Ragdoll Collision Tuning
ragdoll.configuration.tuning.part.head: Head
ragdoll.configuration.despawnSeconds.too: How many seconds a ragdoll remains. Set to 0 to keep it permanently.
ragdoll.configuration.maxRagdolls.toolti: The oldest ragdoll is removed when this limit is exceeded.
ragdoll.configuration.selfCollision.tool: On: all body parts can collide. Off: only parts directly joined to the torso ignore each other.
ragdoll.configuration.renderCape.tooltip: Render the player's saved cape on the ragdoll. Disabled by default.
ragdoll.configuration.renderHd3dSkin.too: Generate a separate 3D shell for HD skins. Requires Render ragdoll 3D skin. Disabled by default; does not affect 64x64 Skin Layers meshes.
ragdoll.configuration.render3dSkin.toolt: On renders the 3D skin layer. Off restores the skin's vanilla 2D outer layer.
ragdoll.configuration.showCollisionBoxes: Show the actual Jolt collision box used by each ragdoll body part.
ragdoll.configuration.collisionBoxLineWi: Adjust the width of collision box debug lines.
